about.title: About NODIFS
about.lead: A bilingual school community shaped by curiosity, respect and a global outlook.
about.storyTitle: A world of possibility, rooted in Kampala.
about.story1: Nova Dhech International French School (NODIFS) brings French and English learning together in a supportive international environment. We believe every learner deserves to be known, challenged and encouraged to find their strengths.
about.story2: Our school community values academic rigour, cultural exchange and the confidence to ask meaningful questions. We work with families to help students grow into thoughtful, capable and compassionate citizens.
about.v1d: We welcome perspectives and cultures from around the world.
about.v2d: We make room for questions, creativity and independent thought.
about.v3d: We treat every learner and family with care and dignity.
about.v4d: We aim high while recognising every student's progress.
about.teamEyebrow: The people who help you grow
about.teamLead: Our educators and staff bring subject knowledge, care and a commitment to student progress.

acad.lead: Strong foundations, bilingual confidence and a pathway for every stage of learning.
acad.pathLead: Explore our school levels and find the right starting point for your child.
acad.d1: Play-based discovery, communication, early numeracy and social development.
acad.d2: Core literacy and numeracy, inquiry, creativity and confident bilingual foundations.
acad.d3: Growing independence through subject learning, collaboration and critical thinking.
acad.d4: Focused academic preparation, study skills and guidance for future pathways.
acad.approachCopy: Our curriculum is designed to build knowledge while helping students apply what they learn to real questions and situations.
acad.c4: ✓ Projects that encourage teamwork and communication
acad.note: Specific programmes, examinations and accreditation should be confirmed with the school office.
acad.langCopy: Our bilingual identity centres French and English, with respect for the languages spoken by our families.
